title: Tasked quest
description: One quest, in one file, under a chapter folder in config/tasked/quests/. The file's name is the quest's own name and is what the chapter manifest lists it by; the quest's `id` is separate and is what everything else refers to it by.

$schema.description: Ignored by Tasked. For your editor. Depth-counted: four levels up from a quest file is the quest root.

description.description: One string per paragraph. Separate from a single newline-containing string on purpose: a wall of text is what FTB Quests' one-string descriptions become.

dependsOn.description: Quest ids or aliases. May refer to quests in other chapters and other groups. A reference that resolves to nothing is an error: the quest could never unlock.

prerequisiteMode.description: Overrides the chapter's setting for this quest.

minRequired.description: How many dependencies must be satisfied. When set, prerequisiteMode is ignored - this is how "any three of these five" is written. May not exceed the number of dependencies.

iconScale.description: How much of the largest square that fits the node the icon fills. 1.0 is corner to corner; the default leaves a margin so the node's shape reads.

showTitle.description: Draw this quest's name under its node. Off by default: a canvas of fifty names is a wall of text, and the name is on hover for every quest either way.

sequentialTasks.description: Tasks must be done in order: the second cannot be handed in until the first is.

repeatable.description: Completable more than once. Its timesCompleted survives each completion, and something depending on it stays satisfied.

repeatCooldownTicks.description: Ticks to wait between completions of a repeatable quest. 2400 is two minutes.

exclusiveGroup.description: Quests sharing a group name are mutually exclusive: completing one locks the others for good. Scoped to the chapter.

text.description: Either a plain string, or a translation key with an English fallback.

fallback.description: Shown if the translation is missing. Without it a player sees the raw key.

itemRef.description: An item and a count. Not an ItemStack - resolved at the moment it is used.

item.description: Namespaced item id, e.g. minecraft:oak_log. A missing mod is an error, not a warning: the quest could never be completed.

id.description: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. This id appears in player progress files, so changing it needs an entry in `aliases`.

anyType.description: A task or a reward. The `type` field chooses the rest of the fields - see tasked:item, tasked:checkmark and tasked:xp, which are the types implemented so far.

optional.description: Tasks only. An optional task does not have to be done for the quest to complete, unless every task is optional.

autoSubmitTicks.description: Tasks only. How often the task is re-checked, in ticks. Raise it for an expensive check.

consumeItems.description: tasked:item - whether handing this in takes the items. Falls back to the chapter's defaultConsumeItems.

title.description: tasked:checkmark - the label on the button.
